card.title: BAGUIO
card.text: The Battle of Baguio in 1945 involved Japanese and Allied forces.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Baguio took place from March to April 1945 as part of the Philippines Campaign during WWII. Japanese forces, led by General Tomoyuki Yamashita, fortified Baguio’s mountainous terrain to make a final defensive stand. US and Filipino forces, including the 33rd Infantry Division and local guerrilla fighters, pushed through intense Japanese resistance, using artillery and air strikes to break through the entrenched positions. Despite challenging terrain and a determined Japanese defense, Allied forces advanced steadily, capturing key positions and driving the Japanese back. By late April 1945, Baguio was under Allied control, marking a significant victory in the Philippines Campaign.
